name: Suriyenthrathibodi
contribution: Originally named Duea or Maduea, and King Chulalongkorn later issued a royal judgement identifying his regnal name as Sanphet VIII.
legacy: He this person also renowned for his prowess in Muay Thai and is credited with devising mae mai muay thai, for which clear historical evidence exists; these were later transmitted in manuals so that later generations of Thais could learn and practise them down to the present

checks.lead: King Suriyenthrathibodi (Thai: สมเด็จพระเจ้าสุริเยนทราธิบดี) or Luang Sorasak (Thai: หลวงสรศักดิ์)—was originally named Duea or Maduea (Thai: เดื่อ, มะเดื่อ), and King Chulalongkorn later issued a royal judgement identifying his regnal name as Sanphet VIII (Thai: สมเด็จพระสรรเพชญ์ที่ ๘). He was the 29th monarch of the Ayutthaya Kingdom and the second king of the Ban Phlu Luang dynasty, the last dynasty of Ayutthaya.
